name: merge-watcher-pr-state
description: Merge watcher (warren-3bc6): src/runs/reap/pr-merge-watcher.ts is the post_reap lifecycle-bus subscriber that settles runs.pr_state/pr_merged_at via the boot-resolved Forge (merged/closed_unmerged/unparseable/not_found all stop; 60s→15min backoff, 7d budget). NULL pr_state reads as unknown, never not-merged. The Forge-native PR checker moved from src/plan-runs/pr-merge.ts to src/runs/pr-merge.ts; plan-runs merge-gate/in-flight import it from there. Boot re-adoption (RunsRepo.listWithUnresolvedPr, staggered one initial interval per watch) keeps restarts from orphaning polls. RunsRepo PR writes live in src/db/repos/runs-pr.ts (size-ratchet extraction).

name: landed-work-analytics
description: Landed-work semantics (warren-bd57): RunMetricsRow carries prState straight from the merge-watcher column; NULL means unknown and is excluded from mergedPrRate denominators (never a failure). New RunTotals/RunGroupBucket fields must be classified in PUBLIC_RUN_TOTALS_FIELDS / PUBLIC_RUN_GROUP_FIELDS (src/server/handlers/runs/analytics.ts) — public-projections.test.ts key-compares against those lists. Adding fields to run-metrics.ts pushes it past the 500-line check:size budget: split builders into a sibling module (run-metrics-breakdowns.ts) and re-export the types. Test row factories with many ?? defaults trip noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity at 16 — use an all-null ROW_DEFAULTS object plus spread instead.

name: directory-difficulty-join
description: Per-directory difficulty insight (warren-8f1b): join the tool_calls rollup's filePaths JSON column (already fileShape-extracted at write time — never re-parse payloads) to run outcomes + same-run path-error retry memory + countSteeringByRun steering counts. Every analytics bucket ships denominators and a confidence qualifier; runs without rollup rows are 'unknown', counted in totals.runsInWindow but excluded from per-directory denominators. New enum-shaped wire values go in src/core/wire.ts; wire.ts has a frozen line budget, so keep its doc comments tight.

name: outcome-joined-insights
description: Outcome-joined insights (warren-be04): structured rollups live in a pure module (src/runs/analytics/outcome-analytics.ts) separate from the callout layer (insights.ts); every rate ships with its denominator + an InsightConfidence (sample-size derived, canonical in src/core/wire-insight.ts). Cost-adjacent fields on the public /analytics/runs body need their own PUBLIC_/REDACTED_ allowlist pair per nesting level; public-projections.test.ts asserts the partition. File-size budgets are frozen: new wire enums go in a wire-<topic>.ts sibling re-exported from wire.ts (remember src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include), oversized UI mirror types split into their own module, and oversized handler tests split into <name>.<topic>.test.ts with a shared .test-helpers.ts.

name: context-waste-proxy-insight
description: warren-6d41: buildContextWaste in src/runs/analytics/context-waste.ts joins tool_calls rollup result_bytes to run context tokens; pre-rollup runs (no rollup rows) and token-null runs are UNKNOWN — excluded from runsMeasured, never zero. Insight recipe: minimum-N guard, share-threshold severity, confidenceForSample, limitation named in detail. New operator-only wire fields get PUBLIC_/REDACTED_ classification lists as data (all-redacted for readOperator surfaces) with tests in public-projections.test.ts.

title: Judge rubric v1: full 15-class taxonomy, banded confidence, locked verdict shape
rationale: An unlogged class is a corpus hole the same way an unjudged run is; the calibration re-judge already measures whether fine distinctions hold, and any narrowing is a new rubric version, never an in-place edit.

title: Judge loop drives the pi SDK, not @anthropic-ai/sdk (pl-17ca rev 3)
rationale: A direct Anthropic SDK dependency hardcodes a vendor into the corpus engine; the §12.1 cost story depends on freely swapping cheaper/higher-quality models cross-provider, and §12.2 already named pi the natural in-ecosystem driver. Owner overruled the plan's rev-1 alternative-#1 rejection.

description: Pi runtime tool payloads wrap tool args in an 'arguments' key ({"name":"bash","type":"toolCall","arguments":{"command":...}}), but PI_TOOL_SHAPE in src/core/tool-shape.ts reads only payload.input.command / payload.command and readPathsWith in src/core/file-shape.ts reads only payload.input. In production every pi tool_calls row (10,583 bash, 3,944 file-tool) landed with command=NULL and empty file_paths since the first pi run — silently, because the extraction counts an unreadable command as 'non-command tool' (shaped:true, unparsed:0), the exact laundering the shape seam was built to prevent. Behavior analytics froze on the last claude-code runs (Jul 31) while 97% of traffic was pi. Lesson: when adding or auditing a runtime tool shape, verify against a REAL stored events payload from the DB, not the runtime's docs; and check the boot backfill candidate query — it only targets runs with no rollup rows, so rows extracted wrongly (present but NULL) never self-heal.
resolution: Add payload.arguments fallback to PI_TOOL_SHAPE.readToolUse and a per-shape args key to readPathsWith; re-mine NULL-command rows from retained events payloads via a one-off repair pass (boot backfill will not pick them up). Tracked as warren-677c.

description: Pi toolCall tool_use payloads wrap args as {name,type:'toolCall',arguments:{command|path:...}} — NOT input. PI_TOOL_SHAPE/readPathsWith reading only payload.input left 10,583 pi bash rollup rows command=NULL and 3,944 file rows pathless in prod (warren-677c). Lesson: when adding a runtime shape, pin the runtime's NATIVE payload dialect from real prod events, not just the normalized one.
resolution: arguments fallback in src/core/tool-shape.ts + args-container list in src/core/file-shape.ts (PR #967); corpus repaired via repairToolCallRollup delete-and-replay from retained events (boot backfill can't revisit runs that already have rollup rows) + one-off scripts/repair-tool-calls.ts against prod

name: analytics-wire-additions
description: warren-bc9c: /analytics/runs wire additions follow two house rules — new blocks get a PUBLIC field-list entry in src/server/handlers/runs/analytics.ts (delivery is public like queueWaitMs; autonomy rides under outcomes), and the spectator envelope is pinned by a golden test (runs.analytics.golden.test.ts, fixture in __golden__/responses). Reap-time delivery event rows must be persisted via the run.ts emit() helper, independent of the lifecycle-bus guard, or analytics sees historical gaps.

title: Spectator analytics: instance-wide cost/merged-PR ratio is public, buckets are not
rationale: The overall ratio cannot be multiplied back into totals.cost while a bucket ratio can; scenario 39 fences this with an explicit allowlist walk of outcomes.costPerMergedPr
